name: Demo E2: Modeled Pipe Redline Route Pickup
description: Run a bounded modeled pipe redline route through /revit/mep-route-workflow and require model write evidence, a passing visual gate, and cleanup evidence for repeated live runs.
setup_instructions: Open the target Revit model and the sheet/view containing the marked pipe route.
Use a prepared deterministic redline route request with ordered model-space points.
Use /revit/mep-route-workflow with kind=pipe, apply=true, and visualVerify=true; do not report completion from a dry-run.
success_criteria: The workflow returns created pipe element or fitting ids.
Created planned points match the intended route points within tolerance.
A focused post-change capture is returned.
Created pipe route ids are proven in a cleanup dry-run and then deleted after capture and visual-gate evidence is recorded.
failure_criteria: The workflow only dry-runs or returns no created pipe model ids.
The created pipe route points do not match the requested redline route.
The focused visual capture is missing.
The redline visual gate is fail or uncertain.
Cleanup is requested but the created pipe route ids are missing from the cleanup dry-run or applied delete evidence.
grader_notes: This benchmark covers modeled pipe redline pickup. It is not satisfied by annotation-only pickup, duct-only routing, or existing callout text without model evidence.
optional_cleanup_steps: Delete the created pipe/fitting ids after visual verification so repeated live reliability runs do not accumulate model clutter.

endpointGrounding.openEndPolicy: Standalone disposable Snowdon pipe-route benchmark; created open-ended route is verified visually and deleted in cleanup.
